name: v0.8.7
body:
## What's Changed
* site: refresh the release snapshot to v0.8.6 by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/182
* test(ui): give the dirty-buffer watcher test a reliable signal (#183) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/184
* fix(ui): one text Close control for every page and panel (#185) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/197
* fix(board): one camera pose per stroke and selection drag (#187) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/198
* fix(ui): centre the Focus glyph and hide its button where it cannot act (#186) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/199
* fix(graph): density-scaled footprint and packing at every vault size (#190, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/200
* feat(board): replace the 240 pt rail with a header board picker (#188) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/201
* feat(import): AnyDoc document conversion crate (#189, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/203
* fix(graph): density-aware LOD and scaled link/force lengths (#190, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/202
* feat(import): import documents as Markdown notes (#189, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/204
* i18n: add the message-template seam and convert 86 helpers (#191, part 1) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/205
* i18n: convert the remaining helpers and close the pseudo allowlist (#191, part 2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/206
* i18n: locale-pack infrastructure — picker, OS detection, dates, plurals, overflow (#192) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/207
* chore(i18n): add offline translation-review tooling by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/212
* docs: refresh README, tutorial vault and renders by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/213
* i18n: ship the Spanish (es-ES) catalog (#193) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/208
* i18n: ship the French (fr-FR) catalog (#194) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/211
* i18n: ship the German (de-DE) catalog (#195) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/210
* test(sync): stabilize the auth loopback tests on loaded runners by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/214
* i18n: ship the Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) catalog (#196) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/209
* Release 0.8.7: bump version and changelog by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/215


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.6...v0.8.7
